case.title: 06:00:00 is daytime while 05:59:59 one second earlier is not

submissions.open_text: We fetch from the stream before the cattle come down to drink.
The communal tap opens at six and the line grows quickly.

case.why: The morning bound is exclusive ('before 06:00'). 06:00:00+03:00 must therefore not fire. Its sibling 'dawn' at 05:59:59 does fire, and that is the contrast this case pins. An implementation using <= 06:00, or hour <= 6, would wrongly flag 'six'. Other checks are quiet. 'six' is a participant interview of 390 s, which is at least 180 s. same_spot never applies to participants. There are only 2 submissions, fewer than the 5 burst needs for a participant. Both points are inside Kondele. Content words {fetch, stream, cattle, come, drink} and {communal, tap, opens, six, line, grows, quickly} do not overlap. There is no voice note.
